files.purpose: Defines the geometry, placement, drag, resize and chrome of the floating panels that sit beside or above a chat's composer: the corner/dock model (FloatingPanelID, PanelDockSide, PanelDockCorner, PanelReserve, PanelDocks) and the SubagentPanelLayout struct that computes panel width/height, docked origins, slot stacking, corner hit-testing and clamping from the pane size. It also renders a helper (subagent) thread as a floating glass panel (SubagentPanel) with its timeline or Hydra head progress, its own composer, an invisible AppKit drag strip, a working-status capsule (SubagentWorkingBox) and a close button that asks for confirmation through ClosePanelPopover while the helper is running. Finally it holds the live drag model with flick velocity (PanelDragState), the placement modifier that slides a panel to rest (PlacedPanel / PanelPlacement), the edge/corner resize grips and their state (PanelResizeAxes, PanelResize, PanelResizeState, PanelResizeGrips), and the NSViewRepresentable drag handle (PanelDragHandle / PanelDragHandleView) that tracks mouse presses in AppKit so the transcript scroll view cannot steal them.

enum PanelDockSide: Equatable { case leading, trailing }
enum PanelDockCorner: String, Equatable { case topLeading, topTrailing, bottomLeading, bottomTrailing }
PanelDockCorner.side: PanelDockSide (topLeading/bottomLeading -> .leading; topTrailing/bottomTrailing -> .trailing)

struct PanelReserve: Equatable { var leading: CGFloat = 0; var trailing: CGFloat = 0 }

struct SubagentPanel: View { let thread: ChatThread; let size: CGSize; let workingDirectory: String?; let projectName: String?; let onDrag: (CGSize) -> Void; let onDragEnd: () -> Void; let close: () -> Void }
SubagentPanel private static cornerRadius: CGFloat = 22; handleHeight: CGFloat = Chrome.chromeTopPadding + Chrome.capsuleHeight + 6
private struct SubagentWorkingBox: View { let title: String; let isRunning: Bool; @State isSending = false; private var name: String }
private struct ClosePanelPopover: View { let title: String; let onClose: () -> Void }

@Observable @MainActor final class PanelDragState { private(set) var position: CGPoint?; func move(by translation: CGSize, from rest: CGPoint, in layout: SubagentPanelLayout) -> CGPoint; func reclamp(in layout: SubagentPanelLayout); func release() -> CGPoint? }
PanelDragState private static flickCarry: TimeInterval = 0.12; restBeforeDrop: TimeInterval = 0.08
struct PlacedPanel<Content: View>: View { let drag: PanelDragState; let rest: CGPoint; let size: CGSize; let content: Content; var resize: PanelResize? = nil; var isResizing = false }
private struct PanelPlacement: ViewModifier { let drag: PanelDragState; let rest: CGPoint; let size: CGSize; let isResizing: Bool }
struct PanelResizeAxes: OptionSet { rawValue: Int; static width = 1; static height = 2; static both = [.width, .height] }
struct PanelResize { let corner: PanelDockCorner; let onResize: (CGSize, PanelResizeAxes) -> Void; let onResizeEnd: () -> Void; let onReset: () -> Void }

@Observable @MainActor final class PanelResizeState { private(set) var start: CGSize?; var liveSize: CGSize?; var liveUsageHeight: CGFloat?; var isActive: Bool; func begin(at size: CGSize) -> CGSize; func end() }

private struct PanelResizeGrips: View { let resize: PanelResize; static edge: CGFloat = 6; static corner: CGFloat = 16; private func grip(_ axes: PanelResizeAxes, position: NSCursor.FrameResizePosition) -> some View; private static func cornerPosition(of dock: PanelDockCorner) -> NSCursor.FrameResizePosition }

struct PanelDragHandle: NSViewRepresentable { let onDrag: (CGSize) -> Void; let onDragEnd: () -> Void; var cursor: NSCursor = .openHand; var dragCursor: NSCursor = .closedHand; var onDoubleClick: (() -> Void)? = nil }

final class PanelDragHandleView: NSView { var onDrag, onDragEnd, onDoubleClick; var cursor = .openHand; var dragCursor = .closedHand; private static slop: CGFloat = 2; private var pressOrigin: NSPoint; private var isDragging }

side_effects: Closing a running helper panel (via 'Close and stop') calls close(), which the popover text says stops the helper's turn; closing an idle panel calls close() directly.
PanelDragHandleView pushes dragCursor on NSCursor stack once drag passes slop and pops it on mouseUp or when removed from window mid-drag (the removal path calls neither onDrag nor onDragEnd).
PanelDragHandle.update invalidates the window's cursor rects when the cursor object identity changes (view.cursor !== cursor).
SubagentWorkingBox runs a .task(id: isSending) that sleeps 0.9 s then sets isSending = false.
No persistence or I/O in this file; resize/drag results are reported via callbacks (onResize, onResizeEnd, onReset, onDrag, onDragEnd) for callers to store.
platform_assumptions: import AppKit and SwiftUI throughout; View, ViewModifier, @Environment, @State, @Observable (Observation framework), @ObservationIgnored, @MainActor.
NSViewRepresentable wrapping a custom NSView (PanelDragHandleView) with makeNSView/updateNSView.

NSView mouse event overrides: acceptsFirstMouse(for:) true (first click works on a non-key window), mouseDownCanMoveWindow false, mouseDown/mouseDragged/mouseUp, viewDidMoveToWindow; NSEvent.locationInWindow and clickCount.
AppKit window coordinates have y running up; travel() flips height to pressOrigin.y - point.y so panel offsets run down.

persisted_fields: Nothing is written to storage in this file, but `enum PanelDockCorner: String` (line 15) raw values ARE a storage format used elsewhere: AppSettings.swift:175 `static let usagePanelDock = "usagePanelDock"`, AppSettings.swift:684 `didSet { defaults.set(usagePanelDock.rawValue, forKey: Key.usagePanelDock) }`, AppSettings.swift:783 `usagePanelDock = defaults.string(forKey: Key.usagePanelDock).flatMap(PanelDockCorner.init(rawValue:)) ?? .bottomLeading`. The stored strings are exactly the case names "topLeading", "topTrailing", "bottomLeading", "bottomTrailing"; a port must keep them byte-identical (an unknown string falls back to .bottomLeading).

SubagentPanelLayout.preferred mirrors the user's dragged size stored elsewhere as AppSettings.panelSize (per doc comment); PanelResize.onReset returns to the automatic size (nil preferred) via the caller.

Panel background layer 1 (inner): shape.fill(.clear).glassEffect(.regular, in: shape) with overlay shape.fill(Chrome.glassTint.opacity(isDark ? 0.22 : 0.16)).

Panel background layer 2 (outer, after clipShape): shape.fill((isDark ? Color.black : Color.white).opacity(isDark ? 0.3 : 0.34)).shadow(color: .black.opacity(isDark ? 1 : 0.65), radius: 28, y: 10). No hairline stroke (comment: glass supplies the edge).

Close confirmation popover (arrowEdge .bottom), width 300: section header "Stop this helper?"; note "“\(title)” is still working. Closing the panel stops its turn. What it has done so far stays, and its chat moves to the sidebar under this one." (curly quotes U+201C/U+201D around the title); divider; destructive item "Close and stop" symbol "stop.circle" with action `{ onClose() }`; item "Keep it working" symbol "arrow.uturn.backward" with empty action `{}`. The popover is built as `ClosePanelPopover(title: thread.title) { close() }` (line 325), so it quotes the RAW thread.title (whole title, any newlines kept, no truncation), not the 24-character cleaned `name` the working box shows.

SubagentWorkingBox capsule (shown only when isRunning || isSending): HStack spacing 6 of MiniSpinner and Text(verbatim:) "Sending…" (with U+2026 ellipsis) when isSending && !isRunning else "\(name) working"; font .system(.callout); foreground Chrome.secondaryText; lineLimit 1; .contentTransition(.opacity); padding horizontal Chrome.capsuleHorizontalPadding; frame height Chrome.capsuleContentHeight; padding vertical Chrome.capsuleVerticalPadding; .fixedSize(); .chromeGlassCapsule(); .transition(.softAppear); accessibility combined, label "\(name) working" when isRunning else "Sending".

Working box name (lines 374-377): `let short = TextCleanup.singleLine(title, limit: 24).trimmed; return short.isEmpty ? "Helper" : short`. TextCleanup.singleLine (Core/Support/Text.swift:26-31): `let remaining = text.drop(while: \.isNewline)`; `let end = remaining.firstIndex(where: \.isNewline) ?? remaining.endIndex`; `let line = remaining[..<end].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)`; `return line.count > limit ? String(line.prefix(limit - 1)) + "…" : line`. So leading newlines are skipped, only the first line is kept, and a line longer than 24 Characters (Swift grapheme count) becomes its first 23 Characters plus U+2026 (24 in all); `.trimmed` (Text.swift:132, `trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)`) then trims the result. An empty or whitespace-only title shows "Helper".
Working box animation: Chrome.panelSlide on isRunning and isSending changes, nil while liveResize.isActive.

PanelPlacement: .offset(x: origin.x, y: origin.y) with origin = drag.position ?? rest; .animation(settles ? Chrome.panelSlide : nil) on origin and on size, where settles = drag.position == nil && !isResizing && !liveResize.isActive.

Resize grips (invisible): PlacedPanel applies them as `content.overlay { if let resize { PanelResizeGrips(resize: resize) } }` BEFORE `.modifier(PanelPlacement(...))` (lines 516-523), so they sit INSIDE the panel frame, on top of the panel's own UI (drag strip, working box, close button), not outside its edge. PanelResizeGrips body (lines 604-614) is a ZStack in this order: width grip `.frame(width: Self.edge)` (6) aligned to the free side at vertical center over full height; height grip `.frame(height: Self.edge)` (6) aligned to the free edge over full width; corner grip `.frame(width: Self.corner, height: Self.corner)` (16x16) at (freeSide, freeEdge). Later ZStack children are on top, so the corner grip wins hits where it overlaps the edge grips. freeSide = dock.side == .leading ? .trailing : .leading; freeEdge = dock.isTop ? .bottom : .top. Width cursor .right (leading dock) / .left (trailing); height cursor .bottom (top dock) / .top (bottom dock); corner cursor topLeading->.bottomRight, topTrailing->.bottomLeft, bottomLeading->.topRight, bottomTrailing->.topLeft; `.frameResize(position: position, directions: .all)` for both hover and drag cursors. For a bottom-docked panel the 6 pt top grip covers the top 6 pt of the whole width including the drag strip (handleHeight = Chrome.chromeTopPadding 12 + Chrome.capsuleHeight 32 (28 + 2*2) + 6 = 50), and the 16x16 corner grip covers that corner of the strip. The close button (ChromeCircleButton frame Chrome.capsuleHeight = 32 square, top padding 12, trailing padding 14) is reached by the top-right corner grip (bottomLeading dock) only in a 2x4 pt sliver (x 14-16 pt from the right, y 12-16 pt from the top); the 6 pt edge grips do not reach it.
Grip tooltip: "Drag to resize · Double-click for the automatic size" (U+00B7 middle dot); accessibilityLabel "Drag to resize".
Drag handle cursors: openHand at rest, closedHand while dragging (move handle).

Layout geometry: default panel width 400, min width 300, min height 220, gap 12, side margin 20, bottom margin 14, min composer width 360, composer max width 820, corner slack 56, compact height 280, clamp inset 8, drag slop 2.
feature_notes: panelWidth = min(max(preferred?.width ?? 400, 300), max(300, pane.width - 2*20)).
sitsBesideComposer: pane.width - 2*sideMargin - panelWidth - gap >= 360.
fitsBothSides: pane.width - 2*sideMargin - 2*(panelWidth + gap) >= 360; below this panels dock on one side only (PanelScene.lockedSide).
composerReserve = sitsBesideComposer ? panelWidth + gap : 0.
verticalRoom = pane.height - Chrome.contentTopInset - (sitsBesideComposer ? bottomMargin(14) : composerAreaHeight + gap(12)).

panelHeight: ideal = compact ? 280 : (preferred?.height ?? min(520, max(300, pane.height * 0.5))); depth = max(1, stackDepth); share = (verticalRoom - (depth-1)*gap)/depth; result = max(220, min(ideal, share)). Compact ignores dragged height but dragged width still applies.
fitted(size): copies layout with preferred = (size.width, .greatestFiniteMagnitude), returns (trial.panelWidth, max(220, min(size.height, trial.panelHeight))).

dockedOrigin: y = top ? Chrome.contentTopInset : pane.height - (sitsBesideComposer ? 14 : composerAreaHeight + 12) - panelHeight. When beside the composer: row = pane.width - reserve.leading - reserve.trailing; composerWidth = min(820, row - 2*20); composerLeft = reserve.leading + (row - composerWidth)/2; leading x = composerLeft - 12 - panelWidth, trailing x = composerLeft + composerWidth + 12. Otherwise x = 20 (leading) or pane.width - 20 - panelWidth (trailing).

dockCorner(nearest:keeping:docks:): centre = origin + panelSize/2; middle = (pane.width/2, (docks.topLeading.y + docks.bottomLeading.y + panelHeight)/2); side switches to leading when centre.x - middle.x < -56, trailing when >= 56, else keeps current.side; top/bottom likewise with the y difference and current.isTop (hysteresis).
PanelDocks.stacked: step = slots > 1 ? (bottomLeading.y - topLeading.y)/(slots-1) : 0; index = isTop ? below : slots - 1 - below; y = topLeading.y + max(0, index)*step; x = self[corner].x.
PanelDocks.corner(forSlot:of:side:): index <= (slots-1)/2 (integer division) -> top corner with below = index; else bottom corner with below = slots - 1 - index.
slotIndex(at:slots:docks:): step as above; if step > 0, min(slots-1, max(0, Int(((origin.y - topLeading.y)/step).rounded()))) else 0.
clamped: inset 8; x in [8, max(8, pane.width - panelWidth - 8)], y in [8, max(8, pane.height - panelHeight - 8)].

PanelDragState.move: grab set on first move to rest; next = layout.clamped(grab + translation); velocity updated only when elapsed since lastMove >= 0.004 s as exponential blend velocity*0.4 + instant*0.6; first move resets velocity to zero; sets lastMove = CACurrentMediaTime() and position = next.
PanelDragState.reclamp: writes position only if clamped value differs (pane shrinking during live resize).

PanelDragState.release: returns nil if never moved; if the pointer rested >= 0.08 s since last move (`guard CACurrentMediaTime() - lastMove < Self.restBeforeDrop else { return position }`), returns position unchanged; otherwise returns position + velocity * 0.12 (flick carry). The defer block resets exactly `position = nil`, `grab = nil`, `velocity = .zero`; lastMove is NOT cleared (harmless: the next move() sees position == nil and sets velocity to .zero, then sets lastMove afresh).

PanelResizeState.begin(at:) returns the stored start if present else stores and returns size; end() clears start; isActive = start != nil. liveSize and liveUsageHeight are read by the layout in place of stored sizes while a grip is held.

SubagentPanel close: if runtime.isRunning, sets isConfirmingClose = true to show the popover; else calls close() immediately. Neither popover action sets `isConfirmingClose = false` in this file: "Close and stop" is `{ onClose() }` -> close(), "Keep it working" is `{}`. Dismissal is done by PopoverItem (UI/Chrome/Popovers.swift:271-273): its Button runs `if let close = closePopoverBox?.close { close() } else { dismiss() }` and then `Task { @MainActor in action() }`, so the popover closes first and the action runs after. Clicking away or "Keep it working" leaves the helper running.

SubagentWorkingBox: `.onChange(of: isRunning) { _, running in if running { isSending = true } }` (lines 403-405) has NO `initial: true`, so isSending is set only on a false->true change seen while the box exists; a panel that appears with the helper already running never sets isSending. `.task(id: isSending)` then `guard isSending else { return }`, `try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.9))`, `guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }`, `isSending = false`. The capsule shows while `isRunning || isSending`; the text is `isSending && !isRunning ? "Sending…" : "\(name) working"`, so while running it always reads "<name> working", and "Sending…" appears only if running stops within the 0.9 s window after a false->true change (the capsule then lingers until the 0.9 s ends). With no initial trigger, a panel that appeared already running shows "<name> working" and, when running stops, the capsule goes at once with no "Sending…" linger.

PanelDragHandleView: mouseDown records locationInWindow, clears isDragging, and fires onDoubleClick when clickCount == 2. mouseDragged ignores travel until |dx| or |dy| >= 2, then sets isDragging and pushes dragCursor, then reports travel. mouseUp only acts if dragging: pops cursor, reports final travel, then onDragEnd. A plain click without drag never fires onDragEnd. viewDidMoveToWindow (lines 724-731): `if window == nil, isDragging { isDragging = false; NSCursor.pop() }` and nothing else: it does NOT call onDrag or onDragEnd. Because the callers call PanelDragState.release() only inside onDragEnd (e.g. ChatView.swift:340-341 `onDragEnd: { if let heading = subagentDrag.release() {`), a handle removed mid-drag leaves the drag state unreleased: position and grab stay non-nil (move() overwrites position but never clears grab, and measures from the stale grab) until a later onDragEnd calls release(). For a resize grip the same path skips resize.onResizeEnd.
PanelDragHandle is reused for the resize grips with onDrag mapping to resize.onResize($0, axes) and onDoubleClick to resize.onReset.

The move handle in SubagentPanel is `PanelDragHandle(onDrag: onDrag, onDragEnd: onDragEnd)` (line 305) with no onDoubleClick (default nil), so a double-click on the panel's top strip does nothing (mouseDown calls `onDoubleClick?()` on nil). Only the resize grips reset on double-click (`onDoubleClick: resize.onReset`, line 623).

Comments record design reasons: a SwiftUI drag gesture lost presses to the transcript scroll view; the minimap rail is off in panels to avoid per-frame hover work; the shadow sits on a separate filled scrim so streaming tokens do not re-blur it; springs are disabled during window live resize so panels do not lag and land elsewhere.

B1->B2: two changes only, both in SubagentWorkingBox, from two B2 commits (git log dd2b86ef..1fbf81e6 on this path lists e6ec1f44d and a12343638). (1) line 375, commit a12343638 ("refactor: share the trim, ISO 8601, regex and lock helpers, and correct the AGPL string"): name now uses `TextCleanup.singleLine(title, limit: 24).trimmed` instead of `.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)`; `.trimmed` is defined in DroppyCode/Core/Support/Text.swift:132 as exactly `trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)`, so behavior is unchanged. (2) line 385, commit e6ec1f44d ("feat(appearance): dedicated Appearance pane, app-wide zoom, sharper text and the terminal's font"): `.font(.system(size: 12))` -> `.font(.system(.callout))`. That commit makes the same swap app-wide (70 added lines with `.font(.system(.callout))`, 70 removed lines with `.font(.system(size: 12))`). Nothing in B2 ties the callout style to an OS text-size setting: `grep -rn "dynamicTypeSize\|DynamicTypeSize" DroppyCode` finds nothing. The only app scaling is AppZoomModifier (UI/Common/AppZoom.swift:18-26: `content.scaleEffect(scale, anchor: .topLeading)` inside `ZoomLayout`, scale = AppZoom.normalized(percent)/100, levels [75, 90, 100, 110, 125, 150, 175, 200]) applied to the whole window at App/Window/WindowManager.swift:175 `.modifier(AppZoomModifier(percent: model.settings.appZoom))`, which scales fixed-size and text-style fonts alike. The point size of .callout is not stated in the B2 source. No other lines differ between dd2b86ef and 1fbf81e6.
